tasks.title: Generate concept pitches
tasks.description: Write 2-3 distinct concept pitches (working title, one-paragraph premise, tone, 3-5 factions with one-line motivations, central mystery, rough level arc) to pipeline/CONCEPT_PITCHES.md. Genre should balance light and dark. Scale ambition to eventually match curse-of-strahd/descent-into-avernus (100+ locations). Do not create any campaign files. After writing, mark this task done and write pipeline/STOP with reason 'awaiting concept approval'.
